snippet.title: Papa Needs A Headshot - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Papa Needs a Headshot is a brutal western-steampunk FPS. 
It's soaked in rust, blood, and vengence against your own kin! 🔥

🎥 Here's the Reveal Trailer of Papa Needs a Headshot for real cowboys!

Step into the boots of a lone and stoic cowboy with a metal prosthetic arm and a vengeful spirit. In Papa Needs a Headshot, you see the world through his eyes: a neutral good gunslinger carved out of grit, rage, and the relentless rage against the man who made him. 🧨

🔗 Here's the Steam Page:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845210/Papa_Needs_a_Headshot

📸 Follow Papa Needs a Headshot on social media 

➤ Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/papaneedsaheadshot.bsky.social
